  \ sections, the\n    coboundary and the overlap onto their shifted counterparts,\
  \ so ell, h1 and chi\n    are functions of the linear-equivalence class, with no\

  \ and drop bounds (Adelic/SectionBounds.lean) -- the\n    residue-weighted degree\
  \ deg_k as a bundled AddMonoidHom, residue-degree\n    positivity 1 <= [kappa(P):k],\
  \ positive degree for nonzero effective divisors,\n    and the section-drop sandwich\
  \ ell(D) <= ell(D+P) <= ell(D)+[kappa(P):k]. The\n    ell-half of the ledger needs\
  \ neither the connecting/surjectivity data nor\n    strong approximation, unlike\
  \ the h1-half.\n\n(c) CONDITIONAL single-field bounded H1 vanishing (Adelic/BoundedVanishing.lean)\
  \ --\n    exists_bound_subsingleton_h1Mod, with b = deg_k D0 + 1 - chi(0), relative\

  \ flat base change, and even stating it needs the\n2-affine cover transported to\

  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank k (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ D) := by

  \ RiemannRoch/Adelic/{ClassInvariance,SectionBounds,BoundedVanishing}.\n\nStructural\

  \ landing a module must ask for the import and then wait. Two teams did ask (I-0377,\
  \ I-0383) and were correct to; the gap was on my side.\n\nTRAP WORTH RECORDING:\
  \ a team's claim about its own import cone can be wrong in the direction that matters.\
  \ ajc-gate reported RigidPushforwardGate as a single entry point transitively pulling\
  \ the others. It is not -- P1Sheaf imports Gate and FiberChart sits beside it, so\
  \ both are ABOVE the gate and needed their own entries. Verify the edges, do not\
  \ trust the summary.\n\nCheap standing check, from the project root:\n\n  python3\
  \ - <<'PY'\n  import os, re\n  def imps(m):\n      p = m.replace('.', '/') + '.lean'\n\
  \      return re.findall(r'^import\\s+(AlgebraicJacobian[\\w.]*)', open(p).read(),\
  \ re.M) if os.path.exists(p) else []\n  seen, stack = set(), ['AlgebraicJacobian']\n\
  \  while stack:\n      m = stack.pop()\n      if m not in seen:\n          seen.add(m);\
  \ stack += imps(m)\n  allm = {os.path.join(d,f)[:-5].replace('/','.')\n        \
  \  for d,_,fs in os.walk('AlgebraicJacobian') for f in fs if f.endswith('.lean')}\n\
  \  print('unrooted:', sorted(allm - seen) or 'none')\n  PY\n\nSuggest running it\
  \ at every session boundary that touched module structure. This is the second time\
  \ the workspace has paid for it (see memory item on run 0048)."
